clips.send: Someone recently divorced sends this to a single friend grinding for success alone - the anxiety that no amount of money fixes a life with no partner in it.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there's an old saying: behind every successful man is a great woman. He says that's outdated now.

Today, he says, behind every successful person there is a great romantic partner.

Relationships are the glue that holds everything else together. Without two kinds of connection, a true bond with other people and a happy, fulfilling romantic partner, success falls apart no matter how much money comes in.

Who's the partner behind your success?

clips.end_words: That was a six tape drive
clips.send: A commuter sends this to a coworker who kills the drive on the radio - awe that someone measured every trip in motivational tapes instead of miles.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau used to measure road trips in cassette tapes, not miles.

He'd put a motivational speaker's tape on the seat next to him and listen the whole drive. A short trip to a nearby restaurant was a two tape drive. A trip to New York and back was six tapes.

He wasn't the only one. Every successful person Kevin Trudeau knew did the same thing: feeding their mind with something positive in every spare minute, including behind the wheel.

How many tapes is your commute?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #motivation #success #selfimprovement #money

clips.send: Someone going through a breakup sends this to a friend who only takes money problems seriously - the shock that heartbreak nearly broke a grown man completely.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says a breakup can hurt worse than losing money.

He had a friend, married with kids, whose marriage had gone cold. When his wife finally asked for a divorce, he still cried every single day. Kevin Trudeau says his friend was so broken up it was almost like he was suicidal.

The end of a relationship, he says, causes more pain than almost anything else in life.

Have you ever felt pain like that?

#kevintrudeau #relationships #heartbreak #mindset #love #success
